meta.name: business-operations-skills
meta.description: Use when running, diagnosing, or designing internal business operations — process documentation, vendor SLAs, capacity planning, internal comms, SOP/runbook authoring, procurement spend. Triggers on "BizOps review", "where's the bottleneck", "vendor health", "internal SOP", "all-hands deck", "spend categorization", "capacity for Q3", "process mapping". Forks context to route to one of six BizOps sub-skills (process-mapper, vendor-management, capacity-planner, internal-comms, knowledge-ops, procurement-optimizer) and returns a digest. Distinct from business-growth (external sales motion) and c-level-advisor (strategic, not operational).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理内部运营流程并生成文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统化管理和优化公司内部运营流程。
copy.tagline_en: Map internal operations and generate documentation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically manage and optimize internal business operations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你关于内部运营的问题，判断属于流程、供应商、容量、内部沟通、知识库还是采购，然后调用对应子技能进行分析，并返回一份摘要。
howto.when: 当你提到“BizOps review”、“where's the bottleneck”、“vendor health”、“internal SOP”、“all-hands deck”、“spend categorization”、“capacity for Q3”、“process mapping”等关键词，或询问内部运营相关问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我看一下这个供应商的SLA达标情况。
say.note: 触发供应商管理子技能，分析SLA数据。
触发容量规划子技能，分析人员与产能。

say.text: 写一份事故响应流程的runbook。
say.note: 触发知识运营子技能，生成SOP文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your internal operations question, determines whether it falls under process, vendor, capacity, internal comms, knowledge ops, or procurement, then invokes the corresponding sub-skill and returns a digest.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "BizOps review", "where's the bottleneck", "vendor health", "internal SOP", "all-hands deck", "spend categorization", "capacity for Q3", "process mapping", or ask about internal business operations.

say_en.text: Check if this vendor is meeting its SLA.
say_en.note: Triggers vendor management sub-skill to analyze SLA data.

say_en.text: Do we have enough capacity for Q3?
say_en.note: Triggers capacity planner sub-skill to analyze headcount and utilization.

say_en.text: Write a runbook for incident response.
say_en.note: Triggers knowledge ops sub-skill to generate an SOP document.
